charged_uniformly: charged uniformly across legs regardless of sign, so no leg can benefit from an assumed favourable differential
dual_books_wiring: dual-books gate runs with the financed book = price book + this uniform charge; sign inversion between them fails the arm, fail-closed (§6)
financing_derivation_verbatim_from_plan_: every trade holds exactly one session and is charged exactly one conservative worst-night band of 1.7 bps (derivation: NG7-A4's committed illustration "~5.1 bps over 3 nights" for NZD-USD; 5.1/3 = 1.7 — caveats DISCLOSED: a 3-night cumulative average does NOT bound the single worst night, and NZD-USD-worst is generalized to all five legs without a per-leg differential census, none being derivable from OHLC-only TD; the D1 manifest prints source bytes, arithmetic and these caveats verbatim)
p0_computation: NONE — constants wired for later phases only; no cost, return or PnL number is computed at P0
